summary: Check Point cloud email protection (Microsoft 365, Gmail) via API, with no gateway or agents: phishing, malicious attachments and links, account takeover.
value: Phishing and fake “CEO” emails are stopped before an employee opens them.
Unknown attachments are checked in a sandbox, and the person immediately gets a sanitised copy.
A taken-over mailbox shows up through behavioural anomalies.
simple: Connects to cloud email through an API — no gateway, proxy or agents — and checks incoming and internal emails: stops phishing (AI builds a graph of employee communications and spots forgeries), known viruses and malicious links, including at the moment of the click, with URL rewriting. Opens unknown attachments in a sandbox and immediately hands back a cleaned copy of the document (Threat Extraction). Spots email account takeover by sign-in and behavior anomalies and detects unauthorized cloud applications (shadow IT). Protects Microsoft 365 and Gmail. Archiving, DMARC, phishing-simulation training and incident response by Check Point analysts are separate add-ons.
notIncluded: Teams, file storage and Slack are in the Email & Collaboration scope.
Archiving, DMARC, phishing simulation training and analyst-led response are separate add-ons.
classification: Account takeover prevention (anomalies) is UEBA; Sandboxing + CDR is the sandbox class; Shadow IT stays in the text.
